cuts.head: over_shoulder
cuts.ofreeRecent: her private chamber in a Han-era residence — holds a book closed against her chest; a small mountain-path shrine at the Slope of the Fallen Phoenix — perched on a ledge or edge; a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; A compact planetarium lobby beside a bench made of dark glass and a miniature orbital map — She pauses on her way to the morning show and opens a little ticket envelope to check her seat; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds a red oil-paper umbrella open over her shoulder; a themed costume event venue with props and a photo wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face; A public ferry pavilion with pale stone benches and a clear view of the harbour at golden hour — She pauses to watch projected sea charts before departure; a neon-lit game arcade — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — lying on her front; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — carries a camera by its grip at her side; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the equipment room of a swimming club — standing close to a high shelf or line
